# `ViewTargetNameChanged`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Notification that the current view target name was replaced by an accepted or matched name.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, NotifyViewTargetNameChanged @0x41a620 (64-bit build) |

Broadcast on TCP 4700 (channel I) when an accepted or matched target name replaces the cached view target name (for example after iscope_accept_target_name); the event accompanies the cache update. No timer. Both names are display-normalized. route is the function-parent path when the producer includes it; the accepting handler is only shown to send the two names, so route is optional. The 32-bit build has the same emitter and member names. Family: custom; no state or error. APK consumer: DeviceService app-state handler (route check disabled for this name).

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"ViewTargetNameChanged"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `original_name` | string | yes | - | Previous target name. [READ] |
| `updated_name` | string | yes | - | Accepted or matched target name. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Function-parent path when included; may be absent. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, accepted - READ shape, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"Event":"ViewTargetNameChanged","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","original_name":"Example raw name","updated_name":"Example catalogue name","route":["View"]}
```
